fix: Replace the three f32::clamp calls in consider_fling with the non-panicking form: `velocity.x.max(-max_velocity).min(max_velocity)` (line 475), `velocity.y.max(-max_velocity).min(max_velocity)` (line 483) and `speed.max(min_velocity).min(max_velocity)` (line 494).
